title: Thai Berry Irish Stew
description: A twist on the classic Irish stew with a Thai twist, featuring juicy berries and herbal notes.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then add onion, ginger, and lemongrass. Cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add potatoes, curry powder, fish sauce, and soy sauce (if using). Cook for 1 minute.
Add lamb back into the pot, along with the berries and Thai basil. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot, garnished with additional Thai basil if desired.
